title: DSH Plugins
disclaimer: A listing is not a security audit or an endorsement. DeepSeek Harness is in developer preview.

plugins.name: dsh-web-ui
plugins.function: A Web UI plugin and theme pack with a task board, Git graph, file preview, mobile remote access, SSH, vision, usage stats, pets, and themes.
audiences: developers who want an all-in-one workbench
plugins.tip: Install individual subpackages when you only need one feature; this reduces UI conflicts and makes failures easier to isolate.
caveats: Large permission surface
pnpm 11 release-age and hoisted-layout details require attention

plugins.name: ModLens
plugins.function: Adds structured image evidence, OCR, layout, entities, and relationships to text-only DSH models.
audiences: users of text-only DeepSeek or GLM models
plugins.tip: Run the health check first and use a named `(modlens vision)` route so the actual vision engine and quota source are explicit.
caveats: Images may be sent to a configured external vision provider

plugins.name: brooks-lint
plugins.function: Reviews code, architecture, technical debt, and tests using checks grounded in twelve classic software-engineering books.
plugins.tip: Start with read-only `/brooks-review` or `/brooks-health`; treat findings as a review checklist before considering auto-fix.
caveats: This is a DSH-discoverable Skill Pack, not a Cordis Bundle
The flat skill directory layout must be preserved

plugins.name: dsh-anchored-standard
plugins.function: Bootstraps the first model request with Minimal-aligned prompts and tools, then promotes the session to Standard tools.
plugins.tip: Use a blank session and verify the first two request headers; do not switch an existing session to this preset.
caveats: Experimental
Project2 scores do not prove general improvement
Primary compatibility evidence targets DSH 0.1.0-rc.5

plugins.name: dsh-TUI
plugins.function: A full-screen terminal interface with streaming Markdown, tool cards, file references, session workflows, context metrics, Skills, MCP, and subagents.
plugins.tip: On macOS Terminal use Ctrl-based shortcuts because Command combinations may be consumed by the terminal itself.
caveats: Requires Node ^22.19 or >=24
Uses the current DSH profile security boundaries rather than providing a separate sandbox

plugins.name: Aegis
plugins.function: Adds baseline-first, evidence-verified, drift-checked workflows for debugging, architecture work, and long tasks.
plugins.tip: Confirm that dump-config contains exactly one Aegis method-pack row and explicitly load `using-aegis` in a fresh session.
caveats: Do not combine bundle installation with another Aegis skill-root installation
Fresh-host release-level routing evidence is still being completed

plugins.name: DSH-better-sidebar
plugins.function: A service-oriented right-sidebar and bottom-panel workbench with files, previews, browser, terminal, Git, background tasks, and extension APIs.
audiences: developers who want a lightweight IDE inside DSH

install.command: npx -y --package @deepseek-ai/dsh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-better-sidebar

plugins.tip: Enable the core file, Git, and task tabs first; add terminal and browser capabilities only after the basic layout is stable.
caveats: Keep the content sandbox enabled
Windows terminal support may depend on node-pty prebuilt binaries

plugins.name: dsh-deep-whale
plugins.function: A DeepSeek Harness Web theme series featuring the community whale character in light and dark variants.
audiences: users who want a themed DSH workspace
plugins.tip: Keep themes separate from functional plugins and disable the theme first when diagnosing UI conflicts.
caveats: CC BY-NC-SA prohibits commercial use
Attribution and share-alike requirements apply

plugins.name: DSH Vision Toolkit
plugins.function: Ten agent-callable visual tools for image QA, long-screenshot OCR, crop, pixel and color checks, geometry, UI reconstruction, and visual diffs.
plugins.tip: Use local crop, pixel, color, and HTML tools without credentials; configure remote vision only for tasks that require it.
caveats: Requires Python 3.11+ and pnpm
Web and headless profiles require separate installation

plugins.name: dsh-ads
plugins.function: Adds parody portal ads, fake games, popups, and plugin promotion slots to the DSH Web UI.
audiences: users who want playful waiting states
plugins.tip: Disable individual ad slots in Settings and keep only the inference-wait placement for a less disruptive experience.
caveats: Entertainment only
An explicit user-triggered verification action queries GitHub star state

plugins.name: dsh-agent-teams
plugins.function: Turns the current session into a captain that coordinates durable subagents, dependency-aware tasks, messages, and a live activity panel.
plugins.tip: Start with three roles and explicit deliverables; more agents increase coordination and model-quota cost.
caveats: Team state is not coordinated across multiple DSH processes writing the same workspace
Agents may finish without updating task state

plugins.name: dsh-at-file
plugins.function: Adds `@` path search and structured workspace-relative file or directory references to the Web composer.
audiences: users who frequently reference project files
plugins.tip: Use path-fragment searches and workspace filters to avoid indexing generated or dependency directories.
caveats: References paths but does not read file contents
Format support depends on tools mounted in the session

plugins.name: dsh-market
plugins.function: An in-DSH marketplace for browsing, searching, installing, updating, uninstalling, and switching plugins and themes.
audiences: Web users who prefer graphical plugin management
plugins.tip: Use the market for discovery and installation, but independently review source, version, and permissions for every plugin.
caveats: Curated listing is not a security audit
Third-party code still runs with local user permissions

plugins.name: dsh-find-plugin
plugins.function: Lets the agent search the public dsh-plugin topic, rerank by stars, and return descriptions and install commands.
audiences: users who know the capability they want but not the plugin name
plugins.tip: Ask with a concrete capability and require maintenance, permission, and compatibility signals alongside each result.
caveats: GitHub topic pollution can affect results
Star ranking is not a quality or safety review

plugins.name: WeShop for DSH
plugins.function: Adds an e-commerce visual canvas for product imagery, virtual try-on, background edits, batches, and short video generation.
plugins.tip: Close Harness during setup and test with low-value assets before processing production product imagery.
caveats: Requires WeShop API credentials and quota
Review service terms and data policy for sensitive assets

plugins.name: dsh-guardian
plugins.function: Adds pre-execution dangerous-operation policy checks, post-execution credential redaction, and a read-only security-review workflow.
audiences: users who let agents run shell commands
plugins.tip: Start with the standard profile to observe false positives before enabling strict mode.
caveats: Targets DSH 0.1.0-rc.6
Not a sandbox, authorization system, or DLP service
